content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed for developers who require scalable and cost-effective solutions for data storage and delivery. For digital creators, R2 allows the seamless hosting of products while ensuring quick access and reliable delivery to customers. This infrastructure minimizes the reliance on traditional payment platforms, which can impose significant fees. For example, while platforms like Gumroad charge 10% on every sale, using NOWPayments with R2 only incurs a 0.5% fee. This difference can result in significant savings, especially for high-volume sellers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Cloudflare R2 integrates with various tools to create a comprehensive digital commerce stack. R2 serves as the primary storage hub, where digital products are kept. Cloudflare Workers can be utilized to manage backend logic, enabling automated product delivery upon payment confirmation. When a customer pays using cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, a webhook triggers the delivery process, ensuring an instant and seamless experience for both the seller and buyer. This design eliminates the complexities and fees associated with traditional platforms, making it an ideal solution for digital creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically crafted for digital creators in regions where established payment processors like Stripe and PayPal have limited or no availability. It empowers creators in countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela to sell their products without the burden of high fees or platform dependencies. By utilizing Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, these creators can maintain full control over their sales, ensuring they keep a larger share of their revenue. This infrastructure sovereignty is essential for building a sustainable digital business in financially restrictive environments.
Cloudflare R2 provides reliable and scalable storage for digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this system relies on its key components working in unison. Cloudflare R2 acts as the storage backbone, while Cloudflare Workers handle the logic for product delivery. NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, allowing creators to accept payments in multiple currencies without high fees or account requirements. Together, these elements form a cohesive ecosystem that supports the entire sales process from product storage to customer transaction, ensuring a streamlined experience that traditional platforms simply cannot match.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by signing up for Cloudflare and setting up your R2 storage bucket. Next, integrate Cloudflare Workers to manage your backend operations, such as product delivery. Then, set up NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, ensure that your digital products are uploaded to R2 and test the entire flow from payment to delivery. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you’ll gain access to all necessary blueprints and templates, making setup straightforward and efficient. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
With NOWPayments, you keep more of your revenue with low transaction fees.

This comprehensive package includes all the blueprints and templates you need to establish your sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
